notes.title: New Area and mini-Boss Update and new sub weapon
notes.notes:
You may have to defeat the Masamune boss again to obtain the Key to proceed to the new Area (Heavy Door near the first mini-Boss in the Pit area.

You will also get another subweapon that can hit enemies at  a distance and consumes only 1 shard ^^

And then fight the mini-boss battle in the new area (still a lot of progress to come)

notes.title: Update for June 2021
notes.notes:
Dodge roll added and a quick access feature to quickly use potions even in a middle of a battle ^^
A couple of enemies added and more to come! ^^ Looking to add achievement system as well in the future ^^ Wish me luck, friends! :'D

notes.title: Lieutenant Update coz its not Major yet :D
notes.notes:
I'm sending this distress signal to all of you whom I've had the pleasure of knowing that you played the game... Let me just say... "You guys rock! Thank you so much for playing the game!"

This update contains new Tutorial scene before the real start of the game instead of the read-only tutorial before which everyone just skips anyway. This update includes a new low tier enemy, Full controller support (99%) because you'll still need a mouse to save in the sanctuary :')

This update is a prequel to the major update I'd like to release in the future which will contain new areas, new enemies, new boss and mini-boss.

If you wish to support the game development, then don't! It's kinda hopeless but since this is my passion, I'll probably keep going and finish it anyway.
